The [[Northwind]] '''Crypt''' is located within the [[Abbey Gardens]]. Unlike the rest of the Abbey grounds, it is not infested with undead from the burnt church, but it is inhabited by the [[Forsaken]] [[Triston Lancaster]] and the skeleton [[Count Femur]].
